items.title: Māori-sourced map of the South Island and Rakiura, c.1841
items.credit: Unidentified Ngāi Tahu/Kāi Tahu source of original sketch; Edmund Halswell (c.1841 transcription); Lands and Survey (later lithography); image published by Archives New Zealand
items.caption: A historical map derived from an unidentified Māori/Kāi Tahu sketch and colonial transcription, evidence of place knowledge and its representation. This predates GIS and is not the Kā Huru Manu atlas.
